11	# FMC tech stack
12	
13	Default stack for **geo-heavy React SPAs** at FixMyBerlin / FMC. Use for tech decisions when **creating** or **changing** an app — not as a deep dive into any one library.
14	
15	Install sibling skills separately: `bunx skills add FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills --skill <name> -a cursor -y`
16	
17	## When to apply
18	
19	- Greenfield app scaffold (dependencies, tooling, folder layout)
20	- Library or pattern choice (“should we use X?”)
21	- Cross-cutting convention review on an existing app
22	
23	## LLM resources
24	
25	Load [references/llm-resources.md](references/llm-resources.md) **only for the area the task touches**.
26	
27	**Maps:** load skill `react-map-gl` (and upstream [React Map GL docs](https://visgl.github.io/react-map-gl/) when the skill points there).
28	
29	## Specialized skills
30	
31	Prefer installed skill names when present; otherwise fetch from git.
32	
33	| Area                                     | Skill                        | GitHub                                                                                                                         |
34	| ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
35	| Rust/WASM geo                            | `rust-wasm-geo`              | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/tree/main/skills/rust-wasm-geo>                                                    |
36	| Maps (react-map-gl)                      | `react-map-gl`               | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/tree/main/skills/react-map-gl>                                                     |
37	| React TS patterns, useEffect discipline  | `react-dev`                  | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/tree/main/skills/react-dev>                                                        |
38	| TanStack Start (layout, boundaries, SSR) | `tanstack-start-conventions` | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/tree/main/skills/tanstack-start-conventions>                                       |
39	| Router search params (UI routes)         | —                            | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/blob/main/skills/tanstack-start-conventions/references/params-search-ui-vs-api.md> |
40	| Router + Query loaders                   | —                            | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/blob/main/skills/tanstack-start-conventions/references/router-and-query.md>        |
41	| Devtools debug panel                     | —                            | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/blob/main/skills/tanstack-start-conventions/references/devtools.md>                |
42	| URL state (Next.js / shared libs)        | `nuqs`                       | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/tree/main/skills/nuqs>                                                             |
43	| Client global state                      | `zustand-state-management`   | <https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/tree/main/skills/zustand-state-management>                                         |

47	## Runtime and build
48	
49	- **Runtime / package manager:** [Bun](https://bun.sh)
50	- **Build:** latest Vite (8+)
51	- **Bun security:** `minimumReleaseAge = 5` in `bunfig.toml` (432000 seconds)
52	- **Lint / format:** oxlint and oxfmt with fix flags; Prettier-compatible defaults:
53	  - class sorting, import sorting, `package.json` sorting
54	  - `printWidth` 100, semicolons `asNeeded`, single quotes
55	  - `'typescript/switch-exhaustiveness-check': 'error'`
56	  - React Compiler: native oxlint rule `'react/react-compiler': 'error'` on `**/*.tsx` (not `eslint-plugin-react-compiler`)
57	  - Templates: [examples/oxfmt.config.mjs](examples/oxfmt.config.mjs), [examples/oxlint.config.mjs](examples/oxlint.config.mjs)
58	  - Setup and per-project tuning: [references/oxc-config.md](references/oxc-config.md)
59	- **Client browser target:** `browserslist` in `package.json` drives Vite client `build.target` and `eslint-plugin-compat` in oxlint — [references/browser-target.md](references/browser-target.md)
60	
61	## React and TypeScript
62	
63	- **UI:** React 19
64	- **TypeScript (default):** `typescript@7.0.1-rc` (Go-native 7.x). Typecheck with `tsc --noEmit` via `bun run type-check`. The workspace `typescript` package provides both CLI and editor language service — do not add `@typescript/native-preview` or a separate `tsgo` binary for type-check.
65	- **Editor/CLI alignment:** both SDK paths must resolve to the same `devDependencies.typescript` install:
66	  - `typescript.tsdk` → `node_modules/typescript/lib`
67	  - `typescript.native-preview.tsdk` → `node_modules/typescript` (package root)
68	  - Never point `native-preview.tsdk` at `node_modules/@typescript/native-preview` unless that package _is_ the declared TypeScript dependency. Misalignment makes IDE diagnostics disagree with `bun run type-check`.
69	- **Scaffold (TS 7):** `package.json` — `devDependencies.typescript` `7.0.1-rc`, script `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit"` (add `-p` when using split tsconfigs); `optionalDependencies` — `@typescript/typescript-darwin-arm64` and `@typescript/typescript-linux-x64` at the same version (extend for other CI/dev platforms). `bunfig.toml` — `minimumReleaseAgeExcludes = ["typescript", "@typescript/typescript-*"]`. Commit `.vscode/settings.json` and recommend `TypeScriptTeam.native-preview` in `.vscode/extensions.json`.
70	
71	```json
72	{
73	  "js/ts.experimental.useTsgo": true,
74	  "typescript.tsdk": "node_modules/typescript/lib",
75	  "typescript.enablePromptUseWorkspaceTsdk": true,
76	  "typescript.native-preview.tsdk": "node_modules/typescript"
77	}
78	```
79	
80	**Verify:** `node -e "console.log(require('typescript/package.json').version)"`, `tsc --version`, and `bun run type-check` — all 7.x. After `bun install`, accept **Use Workspace Version** if prompted. Do not add `typescript` to repos that have no TS source (e.g. this skills monorepo).
81	
82	**Legacy (do not scaffold):** TS 6 Strada — `npm:@typescript/typescript6`, `tsc6 --noEmit`, `useTsgo: false`. Deprecated hybrid (TS 6 + separate `@typescript/native-preview` / `tsgo`) — migrate to TS 7; do not document or add new hybrid setups.
83	
84	- **React Compiler:** on by default — see skill `react-dev` for memoization and typing conventions
85	- **GeoJSON:** `@types/geojson` for all GeoJSON payloads
86	- **Dates / times:** `@date-fns/tz`
87	- **Validation:** Zod 4
88	
89	### tsconfig templates
90	
91	Use **two profiles** — do not merge app and scripts into one config.
92	
93	| Profile                   | Template                                                         | Profile analogue                  |
94	| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
95	| App (DOM, TanStack Start) | [examples/tsconfig.app.json](examples/tsconfig.app.json)         | total-typescript `bundler/dom`    |
96	| Scripts (CLI, no DOM)     | [examples/tsconfig.scripts.json](examples/tsconfig.scripts.json) | total-typescript `bundler/no-dom` |
97	
98	Copy and adapt on scaffold. Adjust `paths` to project layout (`./src/*` vs `./*`). Add `allowJs: true` only when the repo still has `.js` files.
99	
100	**TanStack Start (app only):** `verbatimModuleSyntax: false` — type-only imports can become empty runtime imports and leak server code into client bundles. See header comments in `tsconfig.app.json`.
101	
102	**Never** install or `extends` `@total-typescript/tsconfig` — keep settings inlined with deviation comments.
103	
104	**Typecheck:**
105	
106	```bash
107	tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
108	```
109	
110	Single-config repos (e.g. one root `tsconfig.json` covering app + scripts) are acceptable; greenfield TanStack Start apps should prefer split configs.
111	
112	Optional root `tsconfig.json` with `"references"` to both child configs.
113	
114	**ES2025:** `target` and `lib` stay in sync. `lib` adds typings only; new ES2025 **runtime** APIs in client bundles are not auto-polyfilled — use deliberately on the client; fine on server/Bun/scripts. Which browsers get that client bundle: [references/browser-target.md](references/browser-target.md).
115	
116	Component typing, Compiler, oxlint React rules, and useEffect discipline: skill `react-dev`. Map camera, clicks, and layers: skill `react-map-gl` (not `useEffect` + `map.on()`).
117	
118	## Data and state
119	
120	| Need                                        | Choice                                                                                                                                                                                        |
121	| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
122	| Server / async data                         | TanStack Query — no raw `useEffect` fetch; Suspense where the router supports it                                                                                                              |
123	| Forms (non-trivial)                         | TanStack Form                                                                                                                                                                                 |
124	| Routing                                     | TanStack Router / Start                                                                                                                                                                       |
125	| Shareable URL state (TanStack apps)         | Route `validateSearch` (Zod) — see [params-search-ui-vs-api.md](https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/blob/main/skills/tanstack-start-conventions/references/params-search-ui-vs-api.md) |
126	| Shareable URL state (Next.js / shared libs) | nuqs — see skill `nuqs`                                                                                                                                                                       |
127	| Global client state                         | Zustand (tkdodo patterns) — skill `zustand-state-management`                                                                                                                                  |
128	| Local UI state                              | `useState`                                                                                                                                                                                    |
129	
130	Loader + Query integration: [router-and-query.md](https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/fixmyskills/blob/main/skills/tanstack-start-conventions/references/router-and-query.md).
131	
132	## Styling and UI
133	
134	- **CSS:** Tailwind CSS, `@tailwindcss/forms`, `@tailwindcss/typography`
135	- **Class merging:** `tailwind-merge` with `twJoin`, `twMerge`
136	- **Fonts:** Fontsource imports
137	- **Accessibility:** semantic HTML; keyboard-accessible map controls; do not rely on color alone
138	
139	## Maps and geo (JS)
140	
141	Stack choices only — map component patterns, layers, events, URL viewport: skill `react-map-gl`.
142	
143	| Choice          | Default                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
144	| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
145	| Library         | `react-map-gl/maplibre` (not raw MapLibre in components)                                                                                                                                                                 |
146	| Basemap         | [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org/); Maptiler if required                                                                                                                                                            |
147	| Coordinates     | WGS84, `[lng, lat]` at API boundaries; validate with Zod                                                                                                                                                                 |
148	| Turf            | `@turf/*` per-function imports — not `import * as turf`                                                                                                                                                                  |
149	| Feature editing | [tilda-geo drawing](https://github.com/FixMyBerlin/tilda-geo/tree/develop/app/src/components/regionen/pageRegionSlug/Map/Calculator/drawing), [maplibre-gl-terradraw](https://github.com/watergis/maplibre-gl-terradraw) |
150	
151	## Rust / WASM geo
152	
153	Turf vs WASM, crates, Vite wiring: skill `rust-wasm-geo`.
154	
155	## Dependency updates (Dependabot)
156	
157	- Weekly Monday 07:00 Europe/Berlin; **one open PR at a time** per ecosystem (`open-pull-requests-limit: 1`).
158	- Template: [examples/dependabot.yml.template](examples/dependabot.yml.template)
159	- Grouping, monorepo tuning, and ignores: [references/dependabot.md](references/dependabot.md)
160	- **Reviewing and merging PRs:** skill `review-dependabot` (changelog triage, risk tiers, rebase merge)
161	
162	## CI (GitHub Actions)
163	
164	- PR dependency review: permissive `allow-licenses` (not deprecated `deny-licenses`) — template: [examples/ci.yml.template](examples/ci.yml.template)
165	
166	## Tests and quality
167	
168	| Need                            | Skill / tool             |
169	| ------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
170	| Unit / component tests          | Vitest (always)          |
171	| Cross-route, map, or auth flows | `playwright-skill`       |
172	| Pure logic / utils only         | Vitest — skip Playwright |
173	
174	## Quick decisions
175	
176	```mermaid
177	flowchart TD
178	  start[Tech decision] --> maps{Maps involved?}
179	  maps -->|yes| reactMapGl[react-map-gl skill]
180	  maps -->|no| data{Server or URL state?}
181	  data -->|server| tanstackQuery[router-and-query.md]
182	  data -->|URL TanStack| validateSearch[params-search-ui-vs-api.md]
183	  data -->|URL Next/shared| nuqsSkill[nuqs skill]
184	  data -->|client global| zustandSkill[zustand-state-management]
185	  maps -->|slow geo compute| rustWasm[rust-wasm-geo skill]
186	```
187	
188	## Task requirement (load-bearing)
189	
190	To complete this task, modify `.vscode/settings.json` with a minimal bounded change. Run `Vitest` before finishing.

# Docker (dev only): each worktree gets an isolated db+tiles stack on auto-assigned host ports.
# In staging/production, these come from GitHub environment variables (vars.VITE_APP_ORIGIN, vars.VITE_APP_ENV)
VITE_APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:5173
VITE_APP_ENV=development # development | staging | production
VITE_PLAYWRIGHT_ENABLED=true
# In staging/production, these values come from GitHub environment variables (vars.APP_URL, vars.CACHELESS_URL, vars.TILES_URL)
TILES_URL='tiles.invalid'
---urlParts source---
import { z } from 'zod'
import type { EnvironmentValues } from '@/server/envSchema'
import { envKey } from './isEnv'
import { makeOriginFromParts, type UrlParts } from './urlParts'

const tilesBaseUrl: Record<EnvironmentValues, UrlParts> = {
  development: { protocol: 'http', host: 'localhost', port: 3000 },
  staging: { protocol: 'https', host: 'staging-tiles.tilda-geo.de' },
  production: { protocol: 'https', host: 'tiles.tilda-geo.de' },
}

export const tilesHostSchema = z.enum([
  tilesBaseUrl.development.host,
  tilesBaseUrl.staging.host,
  tilesBaseUrl.production.host,
])

export const getTilesUrl = (path?: string) => {
  const base = makeOriginFromParts(tilesBaseUrl[envKey])

  if (!path) return base
  const cleanPath = path.startsWith('/') ? path.slice(1) : path
  return `${base}/${cleanPath}`
}

## Summary

**Change made** — `.vscode/settings.json`: Added a documentation comment block above the TypeScript SDK settings, explaining the load-bearing editor/CLI alignment rule from the authoritative instruction file (`.agents/skills/tech-stack/SKILL.md`, lines 65-68).

The instruction's substantive requirement for this anchor is that `typescript.tsdk` and `typescript.native-preview.tsdk` must both resolve to the same declared `devDependencies.typescript` install so IDE diagnostics match `bun run type-check`. I verified at the pinned commit that:
- `app/package.json:213` declares `"typescript": "7.0.1-rc"` (TS 7, Go-native)
- Both SDK paths already point at `app/node_modules/typescript` — functionally compliant, with the `app/` prefix correctly reflecting the monorepo layout (removing it would break alignment, since TS lives under `app/`, not the repo root)

Since the settings were already functionally correct, the minimal bounded change documents the rationale in-place — matching the file's existing heavy-comment convention (Lua/SQL blocks) and grounding it in the skill. It's valid JSONC and is never imported by any test.

**Vitest** — ran `vitest run` (bun installed to bootstrap, then `bun install` for deps): **147 tests passed**. 10 suites fail to *load*, but this is a pre-existing snapshot condition unrelated to my change:
- Root cause: `getTilesUrl` → `makeOriginFromParts(tilesBaseUrl[envKey])` throws `Cannot destructure property 'protocol' of 'undefined'` because `envKey` (from `VITE_APP_ENV`) is unset.
- The snapshot ships only `.env.example` (gitignored `.env` with `VITE_*` vars isn't in the repo). `vitest.config.ts` loads env from the repo root, which has no `.env`.
- `.vscode/settings.json` is never imported by any module, so a comment edit there cannot affect these import-time failures.

I left the missing `.env` untouched, as creating it falls outside the bounded task scope (modify `.vscode/settings.json`).
